title: Claims Desk Figures for Custom Application and Field Services: Rework Allowances and Drift Complaint Windows
content:
Three figures are read off the programme when a member comes back about a pass already run under Custom Application and Field Services: the share of acres that may be reworked without charge where a pass is found short, the period within which that rework is free, and the period within which a drift complaint is taken.

| Programme | Rework allowance (percent of acres) | Rework free within (calendar days) | Drift complaint taken within (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 0 | 0 | 7 |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 3 | 10 | 7 |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 5 | 14 | 14 |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 5 | 14 | 14 |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 8 | 21 | 21 |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 0 | 0 | 14 |

The rework allowance is a share of the acres on the pass, and the free period is a length in calendar days. The two move together on every programme: where the allowance is 0 percent the free period is 0 calendar days as well, which is the position on the Per-Acre Custom Application and on the Certified Anhydrous Application Plan.

The drift complaint window does not move with the rework figures. The Certified Anhydrous Application Plan carries no rework allowance at all and still carries a drift complaint window of 14 calendar days, the same window as the Full-Service Agronomy Plan and the Variable Rate Prescription Plan, both of which carry a 5 percent allowance. The longest window in the programme range is 21 calendar days, on the Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan; the shortest is 7, on the Per-Acre Custom Application and the Season Commitment Application Plan.
